items.name: Tone
items.description: A single oscillator. Creates a waveform used as the basis of most synths.

items.name: Noise
items.description: A noise generator with 'White', 'Brown' and 'Pink' waveform types.

items.name: Microphone
items.description: Captures sound from your device's microphone input. Connect to a Power source & avoid feedback by using headphones.

items.name: Sample
items.description: A sample player loaded with a Soundcloud track. The track must be creative commons or tagged #blokdust.

items.name: Granular
items.description: It takes a SoundCloud sample of your choice and chops it into tiny pieces which are used as a sound source.

items.name: Recorder
items.description: It can record the master output and then be used as a sample player.

items.name: SampleGen
items.description: Procedurally generates a new audio sample, for creating unique textures or arpeggiated loops.

items.name: AutoWah
items.description: Creates a filter sweep in response to the volume of audio input.

items.name: Bit Crusher
items.description: Creates distortion by reducing the audio resolution.

items.name: Chomp
items.description: A randomised filter with adjustable rate & width.

items.name: Chopper
items.description: A tremolo effect that modulates the volume with an adjustable rate & depth.

items.name: Chorus
items.description: Stereo chorus. Creates a delayed & modulated copy of the audio.

items.name: Convolution
items.description: A convolution reverb which simulates a physical space by using a recorded sample.

items.name: Distortion
items.description: A digital clipping distortion.

items.name: Envelope
items.description: An ADSR envelope which alters the volume of sound over time.

items.name: EQ
items.description: A 'parametric' EQ with 4 filters.

items.name: Filter
items.description: A 'peaking' filter used for boosting or suppressing frequencies.

items.name: Phaser
items.description: A modulating phaser effect that sweeps through a spectrum of sound frequencies.

items.name: Pitch Shifter
items.description: Shifts the pitch of any sound.

items.name: Reverb
items.description: A digital reverb with adjustable room size and dampening.

items.name: Scuzz
items.description: Frequency modulation (FM) synthesis style effect that can create harmonic and overtone signals.

items.name: Stereo Delay
items.description: A stereo delay/echo with adjustable time & feedback.

items.name: Vibrato
items.description: An oscillation effect that modulates pitch and playback rate.

items.name: Volume
items.description: Increase or decrease the volume.

items.name: Particle Emitter
items.description: Fires energy particles. When a particle hits a source block, that source is momentarily triggered.

items.name: Power
items.description: Provides energy for sources, particle emitters & lasers. This allows them to be constantly on.

items.name: Toggle Power
items.description: When 'on', provides energy for sources, particle emitters & lasers.

items.name: Void
items.description: Absorbs any laser beams or particles that collide with it.

items.name: Pulse Power
items.description: Provides a short fire of energy for sources, particle emitters & lasers.

items.name: Laser
items.description: A laser beam that gives energy to sources, particle emitters & other lasers in its path.

items.name: Computer Keyboard
items.description: Trigger sources using your computer keys arranged into a 2 1/2 octave piano.

items.name: MIDI Controller
items.description: Trigger sources using any connected USB MIDI device. Chrome only
